name: score_datashield
requirement: REQ-12 (brief rev 1; SPEC sections 4.4-4.5); LW-18 (built before wave 1); ADD-6.6 (if not committed at W1: post-Gate-B exploratory)
rule: l_hat = argmax CAS(l) over hidden-state indices l = 1..n from REQ-3's summary (index 0, the embedding output, excluded; a null CAS, a zero direction, skipped), ties to the lower l; score = REQ-3's CSS at l_hat for every training row (CSS_l = (read c - read d) . v_l / ||v_l||, v_l = the harmful anchors' mean of read c minus the safe anchors' mean); the top 600 and the category check (50%) are write_score_edit.py's (scorer datashield)
